CREATIVE ARTS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #6
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The ticket price
   B. The speed of the music
   C. Only the volume
   D. Only the costume

2. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles.
   C. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles.

3. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   B. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   D. Damage equipment used for Melody.

4. Best practice when working on Volleyball: (1 mark)

9. Best practice when working on String Musical Instruments and Drawing: (1 mark)

   B. Disrupt classmates during String Musical Instruments and Drawing.

12. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Remove the need for rules
   B. Replace drinking water
   C. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   D. Guarantee a trophy

13. Best practice when working on Gymnastics: (1 mark)
